hero.title: Running shoes in your colors
hero.lead: Pick a color for each part of the JIANOVA shoe, from the laces to the outsole, and turn it in 3D as you go.
hero.alt: The JIANOVA knit running shoe from the side: a deep purple upper, white laces and a white sole

parts.title: 7 parts of the shoe to color
parts.lead: The knit upper, laces, pull tabs, lining, heel patch, midsole and outsole each take their own color, so the details can match or stand apart.

items.title: Laces and pull tabs
items.text: Round laces through metal eyelets, and a fabric tab at the tongue and at the heel.
items.alt: The laces and the tongue from above: green knit, white laces and a white tongue tab

items.title: Heel patch and lining
items.text: A smooth patch on the heel, a pull tab above it, and the soft lining inside.
items.alt: The back of the shoe: a white knit upper with a purple heel patch, heel tab and lining

items.title: Choose a part of the shoe
items.text: Select it in the list or tap it on the shoe. The part glows for a moment, so you can see which one you are changing.
items.alt: The shoe with its laces lit up: the part being changed

items.title: Color the shoe part you chose
items.text: The shoe changes as soon as you choose, with a short fade from the old color to the new one.
items.alt: The shoe with orange laces, pull tabs and heel patch

items.title: Turn the shoe and look closer
items.text: Drag to turn the shoe, or use the buttons and the keyboard. Zoom in to see where two colors meet.
items.alt: The same shoe from behind, showing the orange heel patch and heel tab

questions.title: Questions about JIANOVA
questions.lead: Short answers about the shoe, the designer and the store.

items.q: Can I buy a JIANOVA shoe now?
items.a: Not yet. The shoe is still in design and the store is not open. You can already design your shoe here.

items.q: Is the shoe on this site the final design?
items.a: No. It is a stand-in: a 3D model of a knit running shoe, used under licence so you can try the designer. The final JIANOVA shoe will replace it when its design is done.

items.q: Can I save my shoe design?
items.a: Yes. The page address keeps your colors as you choose them. Copy the link to come back to your design or to send it to someone.

items.q: Does the shoe designer work on a phone?
items.a: Yes. Turn the shoe with one finger, pinch to zoom, and use the buttons to turn it a step at a time.

items.q: Can I design the shoe in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Every page, the designer included, is in English and Arabic. Switch with the link at the top of the page.

hero.title: The JIANOVA logo and colors
hero.lead: Download the logo files and use them as this page shows: on which grounds, at what size and with how much clear space.
hero.alt: The JIANOVA logo: a four-pointed star parted by two crossing lines, beside the wordmark

meaning.title: What the star means
meaning.lead: Two lines cross inside the star and part it into four points. Together they describe a run.

rows.name: Two crossing lines
rows.text: A runner’s legs seen from the side, at the moment one passes the other. It happens in every stride.

rows.name: Four points
rows.text: The four moments of a stride: the foot lands, carries your weight, pushes off, then flies forward through the air.

rows.name: The long vertical points
rows.text: A guiding star, like the stars that travellers crossed the deserts of Arabia by. Nova is the Latin word astronomers use for a new star.

meaning.diagramLabel: Diagram: the star with its two crossing lines drawn through the gaps, and its four points named for the moments of a stride: landing, support, push-off and flight

files.title: Logo files
files.lead: SVG files scale to any size. Use the white versions on purple or on photographs.

colors.title: Brand colors and type
colors.lead: Royal purple leads. The rest of the page stays neutral, so the purple and the shoe stand out.

rows.name: Royal purple
rows.use: The logo, buttons and the brand band

colors.typeText: Instrument Serif for headings and Instrument Sans for text. In Arabic, Noto Naskh Arabic and IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

use.title: Using the logo
use.lead: A few rules keep the logo clear at every size.

rows.name: Clear space
rows.text: Keep empty space at least as wide as the star on every side of the logo.

rows.name: Smallest size
rows.text: The star 16 px tall on its own; the full logo 120 px wide.

rows.name: Colors
rows.text: Royal purple on light grounds, white on purple or on photographs. No other colors.

rows.name: Keep it as drawn
rows.text: Never add a crossbar to the A, outline or turn the star, or change the space between the star and the name.
